plugins.name: Demo Music (reference)
plugins.description: Reference implementation of the plugin protocol, for plugin authors. Serves generated test tones from your own computer; sign-in code DEMO.
plugins.author: ricercar

plugins.name: Jellyfin
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Jellyfin server: albums, artists, playlists, favourites and folders, in ricercar's library next to your local music. Original files, bit for bit; transcode only when your DAC cannot take a file. Sign in with Quick Connect or your password.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Live Music Archive
plugins.description: Hundreds of thousands of concert recordings from the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive, free to share, most of them lossless. Browse popular, recent and on-this-day shows or an artist's recordings, search, and keep favourites in your library. No account. Original FLAC files, bit for bit.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Plex
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Plex Media Server. Albums, artists and playlists merged into your library, recent albums on Home, favourites shared with Plex; plays show on the server. Original files, bit for bit; FLAC at a rate your DAC takes when it cannot play the file's.
plugins.author: ricercar-player

plugins.name: Qobuz (unofficial)
plugins.description: Browse and search your Qobuz library, and stream it at the best quality your DAC plays natively. Qobuz Connect support: pick your player from the Qobuz app and control it from your phone. Unofficial, uses the Qobuz web API; needs a Qobuz subscription.
plugins.author: anon7627

plugins.name: Subsonic
plugins.description: Browse, search and play the music of your own Subsonic-compatible server: Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic-Advanced, LMS, Ampache. Albums, artists, playlists and starred items, merged into your library, and Home shelves of recent, most played and random albums. Original files, bit for bit; FLAC at a rate your DAC takes when the server can transcode (Navidrome 0.64+).
plugins.author: ricercar-player
